title: Add Adam to the update loop
statement_md:
`sgd_step` already takes one plain gradient step. Add `adam_step`, which returns the new weight plus the updated first and second moments.

```
m = beta1 * m + (1 - beta1) * g
v = beta2 * v + (1 - beta2) * g * g
w = w - lr * (m / (1 - beta1**t)) / (sqrt(v / (1 - beta2**t)) + eps)
```

Return `(w, m, v)` as floats. Do not change `sgd_step`.
signature: def adam_step(w, g, m, v, t, lr=0.001, beta1=0.9, beta2=0.999, eps=1e-8):
tests_py:
import math

def test_first_step():
    w, m, v = solution.adam_step(1.0, 2.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1, lr=0.1)
    assert abs(w - 0.9) < 1e-9
    assert abs(m - 0.2) < 1e-12
    assert abs(v - 0.004) < 1e-12

def test_returns_three_floats():
    out = solution.adam_step(1.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1)
    assert isinstance(out, tuple) and len(out) == 3
    assert all(isinstance(x, float) for x in out)

def test_second_step():
    w, m, v = solution.adam_step(0.9, -1.0, 0.2, 0.004, 2, lr=0.1)
    assert abs(w - 0.873366) < 1e-4
    assert abs(m - 0.08) < 1e-12
    assert abs(v - 0.004996) < 1e-12

def test_bias_correction():
    w, m, v = solution.adam_step(0.0, 3.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1, lr=0.1)
    assert abs(w + 0.1) < 1e-6

def test_zero_grad_leaves_w():
    w, m, v = solution.adam_step(0.5, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1, lr=0.1)
    assert abs(w - 0.5) < 1e-12

def test_custom_betas():
    w, m, v = solution.adam_step(2.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1, lr=0.5, beta1=0.5, beta2=0.5)
    assert abs(m - 0.5) < 1e-12
    assert abs(v - 0.5) < 1e-12
    assert abs(w - 1.5) < 1e-6
mutations: return w - lr * m / (math.sqrt(v) + eps), m, v
